gate_failure_reason: One issue window reached the 24576-token output cap after the structured decoder repeated an identical item. The release gate requires every window to finish normally and strict-parse.

contract.straight_quote_display_rule: preserved as a literal straight quote

preserved_output.chunk_inventory_digest_method: SHA-256 of sorted lines: filename, compressed-byte SHA-256, compressed bytes

failure.repetition_diagnostic: The output contained 33 non-loop items, then 299 complete copies of the same K Street record, and began another copy before truncation. The repeated evidence stopped at 'The ' immediately before a source straight quote.
failure.diagnosis: The decoder could not reliably copy straight quotes inside generated JSON strings. It closed evidence strings before source quotes and, in this row, entered a repeated-item loop. Fixed structural whitespace prevented the earlier whitespace sink but did not prevent this string-boundary failure.

cross_pilot_quote_diagnostic.interpretation: The failure is a route-wide quote-copy defect, not an isolated dense output.

approved_corrective_contract.display_rule: Preserve line feeds and source coordinates; display U+0022 as \u0022, double source backslashes, and escape non-linefeed C0 controls. Strict JSON decoding restores these escapes to original Unicode before exact alignment against unchanged source text. The deterministic boundary map attests display-codec roundtrip and collision boundaries; it is not a fallback or span-repair path.
approved_corrective_contract.array_cap_gate: Any model array with item count at or above its route cap fails before alignment and cannot produce public records.
approved_corrective_contract.repetition_gate: Any canonical exact model item occurring at least three times, including nonconsecutive cycles, fails the window before alignment and cannot produce public records.
approved_corrective_contract.nullable_string_guidance: Nullable free-text schema nodes omit minLength for xgrammar compatibility; the independent Python Unicode-strip validator still rejects empty or whitespace-only non-null strings.

decision: Preserve every file from job 21304738 as a failed audit. Do not repair, resume, merge, or publish it. Run the frozen 19-row all-route quote/cap/repetition preflight first. If it passes, rerun the complete 7838-window, 4132-parent stress pilot under the corrective contract. A new 35213-window production run remains blocked until both gates pass.
